341:t_3:48.en:
$n
「What's up, you guys? You're all here...」

341:t_3:49.en:
$$カレン$$
「What are you saying!? We came because we were worried about you!」

341:t_3:50.en:
$n
「I'm sorry. But I'm all right now.」

341:t_3:52.en:
$$スザク$$
「Did those $$血塗られた眼$$ make you lose consciousness after all?」

341:t_3:55.en:
$n
「I don't know how that mysterious space, the black $$アンゲロイ$$s, and the $$テンシ$$ I've been chasing are related...」

341:t_3:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「If your $$血塗られた眼$$ still appear, does that mean $$ガドライト#pilot$$ wasn't the one who killed your family...?」

341:t_3:57.en:
$n
「I'd half expected it... I couldn't say $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ were unrelated, but I felt a gap between them somewhere.」

341:t_3:58.en:
$n
「And my $$血塗られた眼$$ appeared in $$ラース・バビロン$$ too... The $$テンシ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ must be connected somehow, but I have no way to pursue it now...」

341:t_3:60.en:
$n
「I'm sorry I keep worrying you. But... I'm all right.」

341:t_3:62.en:
$n
「I've managed somehow until now. I'll keep doing the same.」

341:t_3:64.en:
$$カトル$$
「But after fighting in that space, I feel like I understand your $$血塗られた眼$$ a little, $n.」

341:t_3:65.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I do too. ...So you've been fighting like that all along...」

341:t_3:67.en:
$n
「But even I managed to get through it. I'm sure you won't let it crush you.」

341:t_3:68.en:
$$カレン$$
「You talk a good game. That's our first graduate from being the quiet type.」

341:t_3:69.en:
$n
「I've seen that people can change, thanks to the sickly young lady and the red devil of the Elevens.」

341:t_3:70.en:
$$カレン$$
「It looks like you need to fix that habit of saying one word too many, and fast.」

341:t_3:73.en:
$n
「Th-thank you, Miss $$スズネ$$. You stayed by my side the whole time I was unconscious.」

341:t_3:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry about it. More importantly, take care of yourself.」

341:t_3:77.en:
$$カレン$$
「Could this be a repeat of what happened during the $$時獄戦役$$...!?」

341:t_3:78.en:
$$カトル$$
「It may be understandable. Things have been rough ever since the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

341:t_3:79.en:
$n
「But even so, we've found a prospect of returning to Earth.」

341:t_3:80.en:
$$デュオ$$
「From $$火星$$, we can get back to Earth fairly quickly using $$インサラウム$$'s hyperspace navigation.」

341:t_3:81.en:
$n
「We'll return to Earth and pay back the $$新地球皇国$$.」

341:t_3:83.en:
$$宗介$$
「The fighting continues. We have no time to give in to despair or fear.」

341:t_3:84.en:
$$デュオ$$
「First, we investigate $$ＺＯＮＥ$$. We need to find out how $$アサキム$$ broke free of the seal.」

341:t_3:85.en:
$n
($$ＺＯＮＥ$$... It's a system that extracts $$次元力|lc$$...)

341:t_3:86.en:
$n
(And there's the cursed wanderer who seeks the $$スフィア$$s, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... Does that man intend to fight $$サイデリアル$$ too...?)

341:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your $$血塗られた眼$$ are still troubling you, I see.」

341:t_10:6.en:
$n
「It's just as I told $$宗介$$ and the others. There's nothing I can learn about that right now...」

341:t_10:7.en:
$n
「So I'll just deal with what's in front of me, one thing at a time.」

341:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I can do something about my own problems. The problem is...」

341:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not sure... You aren't the troublesome student you used to be anymore...」

341:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why not fill the emptiness in her heart as a man...!」

341:t_10:14.en:
$n
「I was an idiot to ask you.」

341:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize. I... seem to be giddy from wiping out that terrifying army.」

341:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... got so excited, I produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s myself. Naturally, I added them to the unit's stock.」

341:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I am! That's what being a dimensional merchant means!」

341:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... And that is our last hope.)

341:t_10:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you're the $$ＡＧ$$ I've heard about...」

341:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize for not having introduced myself before now.」

341:t_10:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry about it. I'm the newcomer, so I should be the one paying my respects.」

341:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You seem to be enveloped in melancholy... Is your debt troubling you after all?」

341:t_10:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... I've gotten used to that.」

341:t_10:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I knew that myself, but it's quite a shock to have someone point it out.」

341:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...If you don't mind me, I would be happy to listen to your troubles.」

341:t_10:34.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...It's strange. $$デュオ$$ and the others told me you were a $$Ｚチップ$$-loving robot who sexually harasses people...」

341:t_10:35.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But you look like a generous, broad-minded person to me.」

341:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You give me too much credit. I'm just an agent robot.」

341:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To get right to it, your trouble concerns a woman, doesn't it, $$クロウ$$?」

341:t_10:38.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...You're right. But it isn't a romance.」

341:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's that mysterious woman we met in that space who's on your mind, isn't it?」

341:t_10:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah... That woman... spoke to me through my $$スフィア$$.」

341:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... I confirmed the phenomenon too, but analyzing it is a bit...」

341:t_10:42.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's been one problem after another, and now something else I don't understand... I've had more than enough trouble with women.」

341:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's our $$クロウ$$, a leading man in looks alone. Those are quite profound words.」

341:t_10:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...This is good timing. Do you have something like a bouquet at $$Ｄトレーダー$$?」
